completionBoundary: The curriculum model is frozen for authoring. The active GCP source is intentionally not deleted until the first replacement instructional source has independently passed immutable release and package evidence; the frozen curriculum retains zero old item identities and no fallback. Design Interview source authoring cannot enter active modes until its application-owned selection/scoring contract exists.

defects.evidence: The first materialization compressed Coding Interview from its verified 26 nodes and 2,375 source items to 8 planning nodes and 343 items.
defects.whyItMatters: It would have destroyed the verified canonical scale and made all other tracks incorrectly small.
defects.requiredCorrection: Restore all 26 canonical Coding nodes; preserve the 2,375 verified items as existing coverage; require at least 120 planned items per node for every release track.
defects.correctionEvidence: The corrected catalogue has 26 Coding nodes, 2375 aligned existing Coding items, and every node in every track is at least 120 items.

defects.evidence: No application-owned Design Interview selection/scoring contract exists.
defects.whyItMatters: Counts cannot prove executable design modes.
defects.requiredCorrection: Keep design targets and pools blocked_by_contract with a named owner.
defects.correctionEvidence: No design interaction is claimed as active; all Design Interview pools remain blocked.

defects.evidence: The active GCP source contains 360 old items and is referenced by immutable package evidence.
defects.whyItMatters: Immediate deletion would falsify evidence; retention as fallback would violate greenfield scope.
defects.requiredCorrection: Use an atomic replacement cutover after new-source evidence exists.
defects.correctionEvidence: The GCP inventory records exact source paths, IDs, immutable paths, and a no-fallback deletion action. The target curriculum itself retains zero old GCP item IDs.

defects.evidence: The validator can prove count reconciliation and named-axis uniqueness, but cannot prove yet-unwritten items are materially distinct.
defects.whyItMatters: Authoring volume could otherwise contain near-duplicate filler.
defects.requiredCorrection: Each authoring batch must reject a variant unless it changes the stated diagnostic decision under one declared axis.
defects.correctionEvidence: Every coverage target now includes a diagnostic decision, misconception, boundary, transfer boundary, at least two variation axes, and a non-arbitrary variant rationale; the authoring handoff repeats this review gate.

defects.evidence: Certification coverage depends on volatile provider objective sources.
defects.whyItMatters: Provider drift could invalidate a plan after this freeze.
defects.requiredCorrection: Recheck each official objective reference before authoring its first block and before a release cut.
defects.correctionEvidence: Each certification node retains source IDs and official-objective references; the source audit records the current public official sources and their checked dates.
